answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the ledge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Every claim climbs the glacier of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
